_comment: Lane -> browser PROFILE, plus named destinations within a profile.
CORRECTED 2026-09-14 after Sir clarified: the BYU library session is the first tab of a
THIRD CHROME WINDOW, logged in with the SAME personal gmail as the Snorkel window.
A Chrome WINDOW IS NOT A BROWSER IDENTITY. The Claude extension attaches per PROFILE,
so every window of a profile shares one deviceId -- and cookies are profile-wide, so
library auth is already present in ANY window or tab of the personal profile.
There is therefore NO third deviceId to find, and 'library' is a DESTINATION, not a role.
Two browser identities exist, matching the two Chrome profiles:
personal  Default    'Your Chrome'      nathaniel.cannon@gmail.com  (Snorkel + BYU library)
MECHANISM (Claude Code v2.1.259, read from the binary): the MCP prompts only when the
global pin (~/.claude.json .chromeExtension.pairedDeviceId) matches no connected browser.
A match auto-connects silently. selectedDeviceId is PER-PROCESS, so a lane may switch
with select_browser without disturbing another lane. requirePairedDevice is consumed but
never provided by the CLI: unusable.
